events.title: Meet The Author: Joshua Hortinela
events.description: More than simply a space lined with shelves, Harry Hartog is a meeting place between the worlds found inside books and the world around us. Our bookshops are for the adventurer, the student of life and the next generation of reader. Old fashioned quality and creative ideas are the cornerstone of our community.
